changeSet.author: ${claude}
changeSet.sql: ALTER TABLE registration.cost_centers DROP COLUMN income_budget, DROP COLUMN expense_budget, ADD COLUMN expense_budget_percentage numeric(5, 2), ADD CONSTRAINT ck_cost_centers_on_expense_budget_percentage CHECK (expense_budget_percentage > 0 AND expense_budget_percentage <= 100);

rollback.sql: ALTER TABLE registration.cost_centers DROP CONSTRAINT ck_cost_centers_on_expense_budget_percentage, DROP COLUMN expense_budget_percentage, ADD COLUMN expense_budget numeric(15, 2), ADD COLUMN income_budget numeric(15, 2);
